# 📢 NH Reader v0.3.0 — Context-Aware Search, Multi-Language UI Core & Setup Polish

**Release Date:** 2026-09-25  
**Tag:** [`v0.3.0`](https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/NH-Reader/releases/tag/v0.3.0)

**v0.3.0** expands navigation and search ergonomics with page-aware quick search, ships initial localized language packs, and resolves installer process execution.

---

## 🌟 What's New in v0.3.0

### 🔍 Context-Aware Titlebar Search
- Quick-search in the top bar dynamically adapts to the active view:
  - **Search page:** updates the existing query parameters in place.
  - **Favorites & History:** filters local results by title in real-time.
  - **Other pages:** initiates a global gallery search.

### 🌐 Localization Foundation & Core Language Packs
- Shipped initial translations for **English**, **Japanese (`ja`)**, **Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`)**, and **Traditional Chinese (`zh-TW`)**.
- Integrated language selectors into the setup wizard options step and Settings view.
- Added offline translation validation gate: `npm run i18n:check`.

### 🛠️ Installer Lifecycle Polish
- **Deferred Launch:** Removed premature application launch during installation, ensuring the app starts only after the user clicks **Finish** with "Launch after finish" checked.
